# CodeQL findings reviewed and accepted. Format: <rule-id> <path> <reason>
go/disabled-certificate-check internal/checker/tls/tls.go The TLS checker must read expired, self-signed and private-CA certificates to report their dates; it sends nothing and trusts only the certificate metadata it records.
go/disabled-certificate-check internal/checker/vmware/vmware.go ESXi hosts usually present self-signed certificates; the checker records whether verification would pass in metadata "verified" and reads only the certificate.
